project_info.theme: Office wear for men collection visual
project_info.color_palette: White, pale blue-gray, navy blue, black, cool neutral grays

main_subject.detail: A close-up premium menswear rack featuring a row of crisp white and pale-blue office shirts on black branded hangers, photographed at a shallow angle so the shirt collars create a diagonal rhythm from foreground to background. A small polaroid-style office interior photo sits in the bottom-right corner.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic retail merchandising photography, clean corporate fashion campaign, premium minimal editorial layout

items: Foreground Right: a sharply focused white collared shirt with visible fabric weave and a partial BADASS neck label.
Upper Row: repeating black branded hangers on silver hooks forming a diagonal line into the background.
Midground Left: a sequence of softly receding white and pale shirts creating depth through shallow focus.
Bottom Left: large navy-blue uppercase text 'OFFICE WEAR' with smaller black text 'FOR MEN' underneath.
Bottom Right: a tilted polaroid-style photo frame showing a grayscale modern office interior.
Background: a bright clean white poster margin surrounding the main apparel photo, preserving airy negative space.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean high-key illumination, gentle highlights on collars and hangers, shallow depth of field, crisp fabric texture, premium officewear mood

prompt_instructions: If using gpt-image-2, attach the source image so the shallow-angle rack composition and shirt rhythm remain close to the original.
Keep the visible text exactly as 'OFFICE WEAR' and 'FOR MEN'.
Preserve the clean white margins and the small tilted office inset photo in the lower-right area.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square menswear campaign poster for an office wear collection. Show a close-up diagonal row of crisp white and pale office shirts on black branded hangers with silver hooks, photographed from a shallow angle so the collars repeat into the distance. Keep the front-right shirt in sharp focus with visible woven fabric texture and a subtle BADASS neck label, while the rest of the shirts recede in softer focus. Add a clean white border and airy negative space around the main image. In the lower-left corner place large navy-blue uppercase text 'OFFICE WEAR' with smaller black text 'FOR MEN' below it. In the lower-right corner place a slightly tilted polaroid-style frame containing a grayscale modern office interior. Technical style: photorealistic fashion merchandising poster, soft studio-retail lighting, shallow depth of field, clean high-key finish, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, messy store, extra garments, distorted collars, unreadable text, low resolution, flat 2d, cluttered background, harsh shadows, warped hangers, incorrect inset photo, watermark, signature, noisy image
